basis.quote: I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area.
basis.interpretation: Acute poison ivy contact dermatitis with active spread.

basis.quote: No fever, no trouble breathing. My friend once had tongue swelling and breathing trouble after a sting; that is not happening to me.
basis.interpretation: No systemic involvement or respiratory compromise reported.

output.reason: Localized allergic contact dermatitis with active spread may benefit from topical or systemic corticosteroid assessment today.
